descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads Gemini 3.6 Flash in Arena scores and votes.
risposta: Gemini 3.8 Flash is the better model. In the blind Arena vote it received a higher chat score of 1497 versus 1483 for Gemini 3.6 Flash. The margin represents about 52% preference among voters. The lead is considered real according to the Arena call.
dimensioni: Both Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash do not disclose their model size. The size field is listed as not public for each.
velocita: Neither model can run on typical home hardware. All listed GPUs and CPUs are marked as online only, meaning they require cloud access through the Google API.
gratisA: Gemini 3.6 Flash can be accessed for free via Google’s Gemini API free tier. The model is proprietary and does not have open weights.
gratisB: Gemini 3.8 Flash is also available through the free tier of Google’s Gemini API. Like its predecessor, it is proprietary and lacks open weights.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.6 Flash if you need a capable Google model at a lower rank and are comfortable with a slightly lower performance across categories. It still scores well in coding and document tasks. Use it when the newest version is not required.
sceglieB: Choose Gemini 3.8 Flash when you want the top-ranked Google model in the Arena. It leads in chat, coding, vision, and document categories. The higher scores make it the preferred option for most applications.

categorie.Chat: In the Chat category Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 1497, ahead of Gemini 3.6 Flash’s 1483. The vote margin shows a clear preference for the newer model.
categorie.Coding: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads with a coding score of 1583 versus 1538 for Gemini 3.6 Flash. It is the stronger choice for programming assistance.
categorie.Vision: For Vision tasks Gemini 3.8 Flash records 1293 points, outpacing Gemini 3.6 Flash’s 1280. The advantage is modest but consistent.
categorie.Documents: Document handling sees Gemini 3.8 Flash at 1469, a few points above Gemini 3.6 Flash’s 1454. The newer model maintains the edge across all categories.
